question.problem:
Let $V={R}_{1}[t],$ the vector space of polynomials of degree at most $1$ with real coefficients. Given that the inner product on $V$ is defined as 

$$
⟨p(t),q(t)⟩=p(0)q(0)+p(1)q(1),
$$

find the distance between $f(t)=4t$ and $g(t)=3t-3$ with respect to the inner product.
question.worked_solution:
The distance between $f(t)=4t$ and $g(t)=3t-3$ with respect to the given inner product is

$$
\begin{aligned}d & =‖f(t)-g(t)‖ \\  & =‖4t-(3t-3)‖ \\  & =‖t+3‖ \\  & =\sqrt{⟨t+3,t+3⟩}.\end{aligned}
$$

Computing the inner product, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}⟨t+3,t+3⟩ & =(t+3){|}_{0}\cdot (t+3){|}_{0}+(t+3){|}_{1}\cdot (t+3){|}_{1} \\  & =3\cdot 3+4\cdot 4 \\  & =25.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the distance is $d=\sqrt{25}=5.$
